mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signals an overheating labor market that triggers aggressive central bank rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth and UNRATE are both in top 20% historical values, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle economic regime (defined by high GDP growth and strong housing starts), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as the economy approaches peak activity and recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 and HOUST are both above 90th percentile of historical values, or average 20d return in late-cycle is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production signals economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in declining INDPRO periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market that triggers central bank stimulus and economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or average 5d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high GDP growth (GDPC1) and robust housing starts (HOUST) signals strong economic expansion that drives positive equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 and HOUST are both in top 20% historical values, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising CPI periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
